image_description: A close-up photograph of a green mamba snake's head and upper body draped among green leaves. The snake's head is visible in profile, showing its bright green coloration, dark eye, and elongated snout. The body extends behind the head, partially obscured by foliage. The background is softly blurred, suggesting a shallow depth of field.
